metadata.status: Unvalidated success-rate context only; no points conversion or game predictions
metadata.coverage: Accepted regulation FBS-v-FBS plays; no garbage-time filter; unresolved adverse plays withheld
metadata.source_provenance: semantic_ledger.jsonl.gz has event/play/source hashes and URLs; source manifest supplied separately

definitions.custom: Opponent-adjusted success rate on accepted regulation FBS-vs-FBS plays. Success: 50% of distance on first down, 70% on second, 100% on third/fourth. Separate offense/defense ridge effects, fixed penalty20. Higher offense/lower defense allowed is better. Provisional, not complete efficiency.
definitions.external: Game on Paper / Sportsdataverse adjusted EPA per play. Only adjusted EPA is opponent/garbage-time adjusted; other displayed splits are raw. Separate source dates. Not the same metric as custom success.
definitions.limitation: Descriptive context only. No forecast numbers or injury effects changed. Penalties, reviews, fumbles and safeties are partly withheld from custom rates; missing plays and whole-game quarantines can bias rankings. No custom garbage-time filter. Tiny rank gaps are not confident differences.
